log: LOOP 264 -- PATHWAYS AS A CONSTRAINT ON THE OPERATOR, NOT AS A FEATURE
13 annotation sources have returned nothing, and loop 260 says why in one line:
the residual is double-centred, so ANY function of the gene alone is capped at
0.027%. A pathway membership IS such a function. So it enters here not as an
input but as a restriction on the parameter space of the line-specific operator.
W_c = M Theta_c M^T. Loop 262's dense W_c is 956,484 parameters at 0.448
reliability; this is ~20,000 at K=143. Mechanism under test: fewer parameters ->
more reliable -> transfers. CONTROL DECLARED FIRST, from loop 263's lesson: a
random grouping of the same sizes is also a low-rank smoother. Q3 decides.
